location_anchors.prompt_summary: Modern generic broadcast newsroom studio set featuring a central curved metallic desk. The background consists of modern LED light panels displaying abstract geometric cyan and blue lighting patterns. Clean metallic slate gray textures, completely textless and unbranded.

Futuristic generic data center interior aisle. Rows of tall, sleek server rack cabinets line the corridor, pulsing with subtle blue optical signals and vertical light strips. Highly polished reflective floor with clean metallic industrial design, entirely free of logos or text.

High-tech cleanroom quantum physics laboratory featuring a central suspended gold-and-copper chandelier cryostat cooling unit. Surrounding environment includes stainless steel laboratory fixtures, clean white countertops, and cool ambient lighting, completely text-free.

Exterior view of a modern glass-and-steel international government assembly building under a clear blue afternoon sky. Architectural features include sweeping geometric curtain walls and clean stone plazas, entirely free of flags, logos, or signage.
